import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    mat = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    sum_mod = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        mat[i][0] = 1
        if (i + 0) % 2 == 1:
            sum_mod += mat[i][0]
            sum_mod %= 1000000007
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            mat[j][i] = (mat[j][i - 1] + mat[j - 1][i]) % 1000000007
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                sum_mod += mat[j][i]
                sum_mod %= 1000000007
    print(sum_mod)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
